scripts.build: npm run build -w @tome/core && npm run build -w @tome/player-web && npm run build -w @tome-courses/cli
scripts.test: npm run build:cli && npm run check-docs && tsx packages/player-web/test/review.test.ts && tsx scripts/license.test.ts && node scripts/field-audit.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node tools/build-site-docs.mjs --check
scripts.build:cli: npm run build -w @tome/player-web && npm run build -w @tome-courses/cli
scripts.android: npm run build -w @tome/player-web && cd packages/player-web && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w @tome/player-web && cd packages/player-web && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:app-preview: npm run build -w @tome/core && npm run build:free -w @tome/player-web
